instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show who agreed to get which email list, in what words, when and from where, and whether they still do", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:who-agreed-to-get-which-emails and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Optional list (one list's id) and status (active, pending or unsubscribed).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: email-course-subscription (records:list); email-course-interest (records:list); contact-point (records:read).
